journal.text: Quill agreed to ninety up front.
Quill hired you to lift Mara Voss's unedited hour from Glass Chapel.
The orderly accepted your own return shift. The tool reservation cost fifteen creds; entry left a watched work docket. No patient access or recording permission was offered.
Mara Voss signed the Ward Nine coolant dump. Three hundred people, one memo.
Mara authorizes the flush. She says the tower promised an evacuation. The signature proves authorization; her explanation still needs corroboration.
The exported receipt records an instruction canceling evacuation while retaining the flush. Its contents are visible; the issuing key still needs independent verification during The Week.
Ivo Pell and Junie Calder were on shift. Nia Pell signed the housing slip and reached a service exit. She can corroborate the receipt, but a public roster would expose where she sleeps.
Mara authorized the flush before the recorded evacuation cancellation. The receipt's issuer needs independent corroboration; her explanation is not absolution.
The packet reports an evacuation cancellation after Mara's signature and explicitly marks the issuing key unverified.
Trace the tower receipt to corroborate Mara's hour.
You promised to collect Kerr's own unpowered brace without entering him on the depot recipient register. Delivery and treatment are separate outcomes.
Departed through public stairs toward patrol gap. Spent 0 creds and took 1 planned strain. Entry used no recipient register.
Kerr received his closed brace case. No depot recipient entry was made. No fitting, treatment result, historical evidence or witness permission was supplied.
The service archive authenticates the key that canceled Ward Nine's evacuation.
Sera holds the source original and ledger reference. The circulating copy withholds Edda's name; any employer trace on the extraction remains.

Lumen reads the service docket. 'The orderly accepted a shift, not a confession. You still owe the work you offered.' Fifteen creds reserved the orderly’s tools. The accepted service bargain put your handle on a watched work docket. Earlier attention remains; a later quiet route did not erase it. You returned to Lumen to hear the Chapel record. No work was completed, watch erased or permission granted by this visit.
Kerr says he hopes to walk to a table without counting the steps. The brace has not been fitted or tested; this personal answer supplied no favor, evidence or treatment result.
The public account identifies a reader-authenticated issuing key. Nia's private recording was not quoted publicly.
